question: {If } sec theta = (17)/(12), { then what is the value of } sin theta? (0^circ
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given, sec θ = 17 / 12 ⇒ Hypotenuse / Base = 17 / 12.

By Pythagoras theorem, Perpendicular = √(17² − 12²) = √(289 − 144) = √145.

We know, sin θ = Perpendicular / Hypotenuse.

⇒ sin θ = √145 / 17

**∴ The correct answer is √145/17.**
